result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is one clear content bug: an untranslated localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') is displayed as a section heading instead of actual text. Other observations are minor cosmetic notes.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing or failed translation string.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the i18n key so it renders the proper translated title, and add a fallback so raw keys are never shown to users if a translation is missing.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with its name truncated, which is expected for a scrollable row but the truncation happens mid-word without a clear visual affordance that more content exists.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel clearly signals horizontal scrollability (e.g. partial card peek is fine, but avoid awkward mid-word truncation) and confirm the row scrolls smoothly to reveal the full card.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot indicator with no text label or badge count, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 new') and expose the unread state to assistive technology.
